overall_summary.title: Guests are saying
overall_summary.value: Guests appreciate the variety of Cheerios flavors, particularly the apple cinnamon and strawberry banana options, which are praised for their delicious taste and nutritional benefits. Many guests enjoy them as a healthy breakfast or snack, highlighting their appeal to both children and adults. However, some guests have expressed concerns about packaging issues and sweetness levels. Overall, Cheerios remain a beloved choice for families seeking tasty and nutritious cereal options.

overall_summary.title: Guests are saying
overall_summary.value: Confetti Cheerios have captured the hearts of families with their delightful blend of classic Cheerios taste and a fun, sweet twist. Guests appreciate the lower sugar content while still enjoying a satisfying flavor reminiscent of birthday cake. The colorful sprinkles and heart shapes make breakfast exciting for kids, and the cereal is versatile enough to be enjoyed as a snack or in various recipes. Many guests express their intention to repurchase, highlighting its appeal for both children and adults.
